#  File system modification and RCE through improper file-extension sanitization 

High 

[bashonly](/bashonly) published GHSA-79w7-vh3h-8g4j Jul 1, 2024

## Package

pip yt-dlp ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

## Affected versions

<2024.07.01

## Patched versions

2024.07.01

## Description

### Summary

`yt-dlp` does not limit the extensions of downloaded files, which could lead to arbitrary filenames being created in the download folder (and path traversal on Windows). Since `yt-dlp` also reads config from the working directory (and on Windows executables will be executed from the yt-dlp directory) this could lead to arbitrary code being executed.

### Patches

`yt-dlp` version 2024.07.01 fixes this issue by whitelisting the allowed extensions.  
This means some very uncommon extensions might not get downloaded; however, it will also limit the possible exploitation surface.

### Workarounds

It is recommended to upgrade yt-dlp to version 2024.07.01 as soon as possible, **always** have `.%(ext)s` at the end of the output template, and make sure you trust the websites that you are downloading from. Also, make sure to never download to a directory within PATH or other sensitive locations like your user directory, `system32`, or other binaries locations.

For users not able to upgrade:

  * Make sure the extension of the media to download is a common video/audio/sub/... one
  * Try to avoid the generic extractor (`--ies default,-generic`)
  * Keep the default output template (`-o "%(title)s [%(id)s].%(ext)s`)
  * Omit any of the subtitle options (`--write-subs`, `--write-auto-subs`, `--all-subs`, `--write-srt`)
  * Use `--ignore-config --config-location ...` to not load config from common locations



### Details

One potential exploitation might look like this:

From a mimetype we do not know, we default to trimming the leading bit and using the remainder. Given a webpage that contains
    
    
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "VideoObject",
        "name": "ffmpeg",
        "encodingFormat": "video/exe",
        "contentUrl": "https://example.com/video.mp4"
    }
    </script>

this will try and download a file called `ffmpeg.exe` (`-o "%(title)s.%(ext)s`).  
`ffmpeg.exe` will be searched for in the current directory, and so upon the next run arbitrary code can be executed.

Alternatively, when engineering a file called `yt-dlp.conf` to be created, the config file could contain `--exec ...` and so would also execute arbitrary code.

### Acknowledgement

A big thanks to [@JarLob](https://github.com/JarLob) for independently finding a new application of the same underlying issue.  
More can be read about on the dedicated GitHub Security Lab disclosure here: [Path traversal saving subtitles (GHSL-2024-090)](https://securitylab.github.com/advisories/GHSL-2024-090_yt-dlp)

#  CVSS v3 base metrics 

Attack vector: More severe the more the remote (logically and physically) an attacker can be in order to exploit the vulnerability.

Attack complexity: More severe for the least complex attacks.

Privileges required: More severe if no privileges are required.

User interaction: More severe when no user interaction is required.

Scope: More severe when a scope change occurs, e.g. one vulnerable component impacts resources in components beyond its security scope.

Confidentiality: More severe when loss of data confidentiality is highest, measuring the level of data access available to an unauthorized user.

Integrity: More severe when loss of data integrity is the highest, measuring the consequence of data modification possible by an unauthorized user.

Availability: More severe when the loss of impacted component availability is highest.

  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

I want to download subscription only vods from SOOP. they have a marking like this.

[1](https://jpg5.su/img/vod1.N7URtNf) [2](https://jpg5.su/img/vod2.N7URaBW)

I got a basic/tier1/however to called it subscription gifted to a channel. I can watch the vod that are for basic subscriptions. I tried to download such vod with a correct cookie file and login via username and password with yt-dlp. but I always get

"Failed to download m3u8 information: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden (caused by <HTTPError 403: Forbidden>)"

are subscription only vod protected against downloading or you are not able to download with gifted subscription or what do I you maybe wrong?

commands that I tried looked like this:

yt-dlp --cookies   
yt-dlp -username --password 

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Germany

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

~~The Cisco Live extractor has its URL hardcoded to<https://ciscolive.cisco.com>~~

~~However, the new (current) URL of the site is<https://www.ciscolive.com/>~~

Turns out my initial noobish analysis was false and the error seems to lie deeper than "just" a change in the URL...

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

It is a simple site, and it seems like all of the videos are just represented by a unique number, so the URL supplied above should be sufficient.

## Description

[](https://github.com/pukkandan)

[pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

opened [on May 17, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766#issue-1238299309)

Issue body actions

Some known common issues. Make sure to always check this before opening issues. **Duplicates of these will be strictly treated as spam!**

**Useful issue tracker filters:**

[[Core Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement%2Cbug%2Ccore%3Adownloader%2Ccore%3Apost-processor%2Ccore%3Aextractor%2Ccore%3Anetworking%2Ccore%3Acookies) [[Site Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite-request%2Csite-enhancement%2Csite-bug) [[YouTube issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite%3Ayoutube) [[Good issues for new devs]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)

## Intractable issues

  * **[[YouTube] This content isn't available, try again later. #11426](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11426)**
    * You are exceeding the rate limit. Refer to [the wiki on how to avoid](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#this-content-isnt-available-try-again-later).
  * **[Passing Youtube cookies doesn't seem to work; cookies are being invalidated quickly #8227](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8227)**
    * [How to effectively export YouTube cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies)
  * **[[youtube] Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot #10128](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10128)**
    * Your IP has been blocked by YouTube while you are logged out. You can [pass logged-in cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies); however, doing so may get your account blocked. The safer solution is to use a different IP.
    * To prevent this, [try passing a PO Token](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide), though it will not help if your IP is already blocked.
  * **[[youtube] "Video unavailable" with cookies - YouTube blocking accounts from web #10085](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10085)**
    * Your account has been blocked by YouTube, or the video is not available in your region.
    * Avoid passing cookies, or add a [sleep delay](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#workarounds) to each download.
  * **[[Youtube] Immediate HTTP Error 403 on download #11868](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11868)**
    * Not to be confused with [[YouTube] "HTTP Error 403: Forbidden" for `ios` m3u8 formats #13511](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13511), which **is fixed**

# Bugs

  * **[[YouTube] Unable to download video subtitles: HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests #13831](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13831)**
  * **[[youtube]`web` only has SABR formats #12482](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12482)**
    * [Try using PO Tokens](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide) with the `mweb` or `web_creator` player clients
  * [[youtube:tab] Shorts playlists: Only 100 shorts are extracted from playlist #11130](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11130)
  * [[Vimeo] HTTP Error 429/403 When Using Impersonate Target #10422](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10422)
  * [[twitch] Cannot extract more than 100 VODs from a channel when providing cookies to yt-dlp #7058](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7058)
    * Do not pass cookies to yt-dlp
  * **[[facebook] Cannot parse data #4311](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4311)**
  * **[[instagram:user] ERROR: Unable to extract data #4394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4394)**
  * **[[instagram] "General metadata extraction failed" / extractor needs better fallback(s) #7165](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7165)**
  * [`--ap-mso DTV` Broken: Unable to extract post url #2188](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2188)
  * [[ytmusic] Parse metadata from music.youtube.com #622](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/622) / [[Youtube] Can't download "Music Charts" at format 141 #5546](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5546)
    * Metadata from youtube.com is used for ytmusic
  * [Twitch live streams have out of sync audio and lowered pitch #4280](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4280)
    * Use `--live-from-start` or `--fixup never`
  * [Cannot download video from udemy #1164](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1164)
  * [\--trim-filenames fails to clip file name properly when there is a dot in a video title #2314](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2314)
    * Use `-o %(title).200B.%(ext)s`
  * [[teachable] ERROR: Unable to find Video URL https://edu.ecomsuccess.pk/courses/enrolled/903296 #3564](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3564)
  * [CeskaTelevize broken #6539](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6539)

  * [[Viu] URLs are using generic extractor instead of Viu extractor #6482](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6482)
  * [[abciview] [zee5] ERROR: Data must be padded to 16 byte boundary in CBC mode #3810](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3810)
  * [[Ixigua] ERROR: Failed to get SSR_HYDRATED_DATA #5374](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5374)
  * [Douyin always errors saying fresh cookies are needed, even when passing them #9667](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9667)
  * **[[TikTok:live] Livestreams are mistaken as "not currently live" after JSON metadata request #11921](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11921)**
  * [[tiktok] API returns empty response #13134](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13134)

# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[Rumble] Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden #15089](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15089)**
    * Cloudflare is blocking your IP. Follow [this answer in the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#im-getting-http-error-403-and-the-site-has-an-open-issue-on-the-tracker-thats-labeled-cloudflare-related-what-can-i-do)
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [Filename too long](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * `-o %(title).200B.%(ext)s`
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)
  * [Ability to strip Emoji from downloaded file  #4836](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4836) / [File names use "full-width" special characters: '？' vs '?' #5014](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5014)
  * [[Youtube] Extract exact timestamps #1803](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1803)
  * [[Feature Request] Crop to square thumbnail when embedding in MP3s #429 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/429#issuecomment-2282554440)
  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)
  * [Youtube bestvideo and vp9 preference. #1232 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1232#issuecomment-939635345)
  * [repo: git log broken by SSH signature #7322](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7322)
  * [download comments into separate comments.json file #2372 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2372#issuecomment-1506413976)
  * [How to force a conversion to a specific video codec? #7607 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7607#issuecomment-1636960750)
  * [How to download youtube videos in mp4 format? #8880](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8880)
  * [How do I properly pass my Soundcloud oauth token to yt-dlp? #12249 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12249#issuecomment-2628937389)
  * [[youtube] 256kbps music formats not being extracted #12455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12455#issuecomment-2677077342)



**PS** : These are just the most common issues at the moment. Make sure to [search for duplicates](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) in general before opening issues. Looking at this is not an excuse to not search for other duplicates!

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I have been successfully download videos from watch ESPN or ESPN+ for a while, but this has recently stopped working. Typically I run the command 'yt-dlp --cookies-from-browser firefox "<https://www.espn.com/watch/player/_/id/a3c7ec29-f4c0-46e9-a537-276f0c2675cf>"'. This will successfully using the cookies from firefox for authentication and then start the download. This portion still works correctly. However, after starting the download it immediately gets a response of 410: Gone.

I have tried uninstalling yt-dlp, updating, updating python, etc but continue to receive the same error.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

Worldwide

# [Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support #15012

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

Closed

[Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support#15012

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on Nov 12, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012#issue-3614398875)

Issue body actions

This is a follow-up to [#14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404), which announced that yt-dlp will _soon_ require an external JavaScript runtime (e.g. Deno) in order to fully support downloading from YouTube.

### With the release of [yt-dlp version `2025.11.12`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2025.11.12), external JavaScript runtime support has arrived.

### All users who intend to use yt-dlp with YouTube are strongly encouraged to install one of the supported JS runtimes.

The following JavaScript runtimes are currently supported (_in order of recommendation, from strongest to weakest_):

  1. ### Deno

     * **recommended for most users**
     * <https://deno.com/>
     * <https://github.com/denoland/deno>
       * note: _if downloading from[Deno's GitHub releases](https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/latest), get `deno` **not** `denort`_
     * minimum Deno version supported by yt-dlp: `2.0.0`
       * _the latest version of Deno is strongly recommended_
  2. ### Node

     * <https://nodejs.org/>
     * minimum Node version supported by yt-dlp: `20.0.0`
       * _if using Node, the latest version (25+) is strongly recommended for security reasons_
  3. ### QuickJS

     * <https://bellard.org/quickjs/>
     * minimum QuickJS version supported by yt-dlp: `2023-12-9`
       * _if using QuickJS, version`2025-4-26` or later is strongly recommended for performance reasons_
  4. ### QuickJS-ng

     * <https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/>
     * all versions are supported by yt-dlp; however, **[upstream QuickJS](https://bellard.org/quickjs/) is recommended instead** for performance reasons
  5. ### Bun

     * <https://bun.com/>
     * minimum Bun version supported by yt-dlp: `1.0.31`
       * _if using Bun, the latest version is strongly recommended_



Note that only `deno` is enabled by default; all others are disabled by default for security reasons. See [the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) for more details.

* * *

_In addition to_ the JavaScript runtime, yt-dlp also requires the [yt-dlp-ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) component in order to operate the JS runtime.

**NOTE:** This component **is already included in all of the[official yt-dlp executables](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest)**.  
Similarly, if you've installed & upgraded the yt-dlp Python package with the `default` extra (`yt-dlp[default]`), **then you already have the yt-dlp-ejs component**.

If you've installed yt-dlp another way, then please refer to [section 2 of the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#step-2-install-ejs-challenge-solver-scripts) for more details.

* * *

Support for YouTube without a JavaScript runtime is now considered "deprecated." It does still work somewhat; however, format availability will be limited, and severely so in some cases (e.g. for logged-in users). Format availability without a JS runtime is expected to worsen as time goes on, and this will not be considered a "bug" but rather an inevitability for which there is no solution. It's also expected that, eventually, support for YouTube will not be possible at all without a JS runtime.

* * *

If you have questions, please refer to the EJS wiki page, the previous announcement's FAQ, and the README before commenting or opening a new issue:

  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS>
  * [[Announcement] Upcoming new requirements for YouTube downloads #14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404)
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#dependencies>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#general-options>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#youtube-ejs>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#plugins>



* * *

## Notes to package maintainers

If you are maintaining a downstream package of yt-dlp, we offer the following guidance:

  * The `yt-dlp` repository, source tarball, PyPI source distribution and built distribution (wheel) are still licensed under The Unlicense (public domain); however, **when the`yt-dlp-ejs` package is built, it bundles code licensed under ISC and MIT.** This is the primary reason why `yt-dlp-ejs` was split off into a [separate repository](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) and [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/yt-dlp-ejs)

  * If `yt-dlp` is packaged as a Python package in your repository, `yt-dlp-ejs` would ideally be packaged separately

  * `yt-dlp-ejs` is technically an _optional_ Python dependency of yt-dlp, but YouTube support is deprecated without it

  * **Each version of`yt-dlp` will be pinned to a specific version of `yt-dlp-ejs` and yt-dlp will reject any other `yt-dlp-ejs` version.** Refer to yt-dlp's [`pyproject.toml`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/2025.11.12/pyproject.toml#L59) for the pinned version

  * If your repository packages `yt-dlp` _as the zipimport binary instead of as a Python package_ , you can use `make yt-dlp-extra` to build the zip executable with `yt-dlp-ejs` included. (The Makefile will look for the `yt-dlp-ejs` wheel in the `build` subdirectory, or the extracted built distribution in the `yt_dlp_ejs` subdirectory)

  * `deno`, `nodejs`, `quickjs` and/or `bun` should be _optional_ dependencies of `yt-dlp`. But again, YouTube support is deprecated without _one_ of them

  * While `yt-dlp-ejs` and the external JavaScript runtimes are currently only used with YouTube, yt-dlp's usage of these may be expanded in the future (and necessarily so)




If this guidance is insufficient, or if you are a developer integrating yt-dlp into your software and you have further questions, please open a [new GitHub issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/new?template=6_question.yml).

I am trying to use YT-DLP to download whole courses (Not just the one video) on the site Pluralsight.com by using the following script

yt-dlp   
\--netrc   
-f "bestvideo[height<=1080]+bestaudio/best"   
\--output "/Users/$(whoami)/PluralsightDownloads/%(playlist)s/%(chapter_number)02d - %(chapter)s/%(playlist_index)02d - %(title)s.%(ext)s"   
\--min-sleep-interval 30 --max-sleep-interval 90   
\--write-subs --sub-langs en --embed-subs --convert-subs srt   
\--embed-thumbnail   
\--no-mtime --no-abort-on-error   
\--verbose   
<https://app.pluralsight.com/library/courses/kali-linux-exploitation/table-of-contents>

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

UK

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The extractor no longer manages to download the videos from peloton where previously it was able to.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Not geo-locked, but supporter-only

### Example URLs

  * Single video: <https://armchairhistory.tv/supporters/videos/148868>



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am a supporter (at the Recruit level) and can provide login credentials confidentially as required.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

You create a free account and can then stream video. I'm not sure how they authenticate the process to download video but in the inspect element there is a playlist.m3u8 which has the video info. I've been able to use mpv to stream playlist.m3u8 in inspect element. The site does track how much you've viewed the video but that isn't necessary for the extractor.

The extractor would make it easier to review watched videos offline without going through the hassle of opening the site which is very slow

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

All

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Recently WrestleUniverse seems to have added Irvine to VOD uploads but livestreams are unchanged, at least for now. Unable to download and get an error that YTDLP is unable to work with Irvine URL scheme

  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Germany

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Trying to download something from Google podcasts with `--cookies-from-browser firefox` while logged in there leads to:
    
    
    ERROR: [google:podcasts] NjMzYjAwYzk2NDAwZTgwMDExN2U1MTEz: Unable to download JSON metadata: HTTP Error 400: Bad Request (caused by <HTTPError 400: Bad Request>)
    

With `--no-config` (so without cookies) it works. I can work around this for now by not using my config file for this one command, since I do not care that much about marking it as watched.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

-I 1 <https://feeds.megaphone.fm/lateralcast>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Various podcast platforms insert advertisements before and in the middle of episodes. These are NOT part of the original audio stream, but added by the platform, which is clear because I get German ads in an English podcast and they change occasionally, even for the same episode link. Since yt-dlp doesn't download ads from other platforms, I would expect them to be left out here, too.

I have pasted a bunch of links that I just tested into this issue. If I should open separate issues for all of them, then I can, but I think the system that is used to insert them is the same for all of them, because often the same ad appears on multiple platforms.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am encountering an issue with downloading multiple videos from iQIYI. About a week ago, everything was working fine. However, now I am consistently getting the following error:

Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 413: Request Entity Too Large

To temporarily resolve the issue, I have to repeatedly refresh the iQIYI page and export a new cookie. This workaround is inconvenient and disruptive.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# [YouTube] Better handling of missing channel tabs, and the videos tab specifically #10804

[YouTube] Better handling of missing channel tabs, and the videos tab specifically#10804

Copy link

[incompleteFurther information is needed](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22incomplete%22)Further information is needed[site-enhancementFeature request for some website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-enhancement%22)Feature request for some website[site:youtube](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site%3Ayoutube%22)

[](https://github.com/cow1337killer3)

## Description

[](https://github.com/cow1337killer3)

[cow1337killer3](https://github.com/cow1337killer3)

opened [on Aug 20, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10804#issue-2475754251)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If you download an empty playlist (with 0 videos), yt-dlp doesn't throw an error. I think that makes the most sense and that behavior should also be used for when a channel doesn't have a tab specified in a URL. So when trying to download `<channel URL>/shorts` on a channel that doesn't have a shorts tab, it shouldn't throw an error and just consider it successfully downloaded... since you technically did successfully download all 0 shorts that were available. A warning could optionally be output to console as well.

Another more specific issue is that Topic channels don't have a videos tab, but they still can have uploaded videos. In this instance, I think yt-dlp should instead try to download the channel's uploads playlist. [Here's a comment describing how a playlist of a channel's uploads can be found](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9673#issuecomment-2298830799).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    This bug is related to the semantics/behavior of yt-dlp

## Description

[](https://github.com/SpidyBoYz)

[SpidyBoYz](https://github.com/SpidyBoYz)

opened [on Jul 29, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10597#issue-2435913574)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp downloaders are parsing the base urls for the mpd fragments wrongly. Like if the the mpd url is having any of the query strings and relative base url is specified in the mpd file. Then it forms the base url for the fragments as `<MPD_URL>?<SOME_QUERY_STRINGS>/<BASE_URL_MENTIONED_IN_THE_MPD>`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Ongoing membership live streams appear on the website under the `/live` tab, but do not appear when trying to download the tab with `yt-dlp`.

Once the stream is complete (not live), it appears normally.  
The stream _does_ appear when giving yt-dlp the `/membership` tab instead.

This is with my main Google/YouTube account, so I am not willing to share the account details in this case, sorry.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

china

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I used the `download_ranges` parameter to download video clips, but I found that even if the download is successful, a large portion of the video will freeze. For example, when downloading an 8-second clip, it might get stuck at the 3-second frame, and the following 5 seconds of video would not change.  
ydl_opts = {  
"proxy": self.proxy,  
"outtmpl": '{}.%(ext)s'.format(video_path_no_endswitch),  
"format": video_format_string,  
"quiet": True,  
"no_warnings": True,  
"noprogress":True,  
"socket_timeout":30, # 读取超时  
"timeout": 3,  
"merge_output_format": 'mp4',  
"force_keyframes_at_cuts": True,  
"download_ranges" : lambda _, __:[{  
'start_time' : self.cut_time[0],  
'end_time' : self.cut_time[1]  
}]  
# "download_ranges": yt_dlp.utils.download_range_func([], [[self.cut_time[0],self.cut_time[1]]]),  
}

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates

France

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am trying to download a video that was shared with me on SharePoint. Unfortunately, the downloaded video is not a video, but rather an HTML document "access denied"

I can give the URL, but unfortunately, it's a private video with a required login.

Copy link

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/SheevaPlug)

## Description

[](https://github.com/SheevaPlug)

[SheevaPlug](https://github.com/SheevaPlug)

opened [on Dec 5, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15245#issue-3699571182)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

Hello, in my own (multithreaded) Python program I use one instance of yt-dlp's YoutubeDL class per thread, which is easy and works very well for the most part. But then I have trouble to find out how to shutdown my program gracefully, so that on Ctrl+C / SIGINT / KeyboardInterrupt it would stop the downloads and then wait for ffmpeg(1) to finish. Instead, my program stops immediately not only itself, but ffmpeg, too, thus leaving a .mp4.part file (that can then easily be converted to .mp4, but...). How does yt-dlp handle this? What or where in the code can I look for?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Copy link

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/setoelkahfi)

## Description

[](https://github.com/setoelkahfi)

[setoelkahfi](https://github.com/setoelkahfi)

opened [on Dec 6, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15255#issue-3702725747)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

There is no way to use the Chrome extension on an incognito mode that is mention in this [docs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies). Does anyone realize it?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

Spain

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've read [#14349](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14349) (Github doesn't properly attach the issue link) before writing this issue.

Directly copy and pasting the .html url gives a "`Unable to extract article`" error message. After manually extracting the .m3u8 file through the "network" tab of my browser, pasting both the .m3u8 normaly and with the `hdnts` https variable gives a `<HTTPError 403: Forbidden>`.

I've tried downloading the m3u8 + hdnts with ffmpeg and it works succesfully.

Thanks in advance. It's the first time posting issues here. Hope it's everything correct.

FFmpeg downloader must verify TLS certificates#14407

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/nihil-admirari)

## Description

[](https://github.com/nihil-admirari)

[nihil-admirari](https://github.com/nihil-admirari)

opened [on Sep 23, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14407#issue-3445328276)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

From [BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds#505](https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/issues/505):

> FFmpeg simply did not check the validity of any certificates until yesterday.  
>  Builds starting from today should finally use the system cert store, though verifying certificates is still turned off by default, since just enabling it would be a breaking change.

Verification can be enabled by passing [`-verify 1`](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-protocols.html#tls) on the command line.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

I have yt-dlp downloaded in termux and I want to know why all other js libraries are marked as unavailable when they just need to be toggled. I know this because the quickjs works.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Option for not following HTTP redirects#14542

[#14544](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/14544)

Labels

[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request

[](https://github.com/cynthia2006)

## Description

[](https://github.com/cynthia2006)

[cynthia2006](https://github.com/cynthia2006)

opened [on Oct 4, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14542#issue-3483769930)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

During the development of an extractor (in a plugin), I required to use `_download_webpage()` in manner that allows the content to be read from a HTTP 302 response; much as what would happen with `curl` without the `-L` flag.

Unfortunately, it seems that yt-dlp is hardcoded to follow redirects, and there's no feasible method to stop this behaviour. I require this, for otherwise the webpage redirects to its login page.

The most feasible would have been if there was a `allow_redirects` boolean flag akin to Python requests to toggle this behaviour at a per-request or per-extractor level. I'm not sure why it's not already there, but it would have been useful if it was.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I'd like to float out the `Downloading item k of N` message (when downloading playlists) to the console titlebar, as well as emitting a `Processing argument k of N` message. I've found `--progress-template`, but the contents of the `progress` dict it passes are unclear, but if I'm reading `yt_dlp.YoutubeDL.py` correctly that data doesn't get passed?  
Please add these fields to the `progress` dict, or clarify how to spell `--progress-template` if this is doable.

To clarify, I expect to be able to get my desired behaviour with `--progress-template 'Processing item %(progress.item_no)s of %(progress.item_count)s (argument %(progress.argc)s of %(progress.arg_count)s)'` or something similar.

Flag to treat broken symbolic links as present files#14957

## Description

[](https://github.com/hatzka-nezumi)

[hatzka-nezumi](https://github.com/hatzka-nezumi)

opened [on Nov 9, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14957#issue-3604402488)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

This is niche, but I use [git-annex](https://git-annex.branchable.com/) to manage my media, which means the folder where I keep everything contains many broken symbolic links representing files which (to a first approximation) exist somewhere, but not necessarily here.

yt-dlp sees broken symbolic links as nonexistent files, which is usually correct. But in this case, I'd like to be able to tell it to treat them as present, so that I don't have to have all my videos available on the same drive where I run yt-dlp. I think the only change needed would be to use `os.path.lexists` instead of `os.path.exists`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/WillPittenger)

[WillPittenger](https://github.com/WillPittenger)

opened [on Oct 3, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14533#issue-3479441104)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When you download the JSON with `-J` for large playlists, it can take a long time. Hence it'd be helpful if yt-dlp could display a progress while downloading. I tried using `--console`, but that had no effect. You don't notice when you save the videos in the playlist as it downloads the JSON for the playlist only first with only the IDs first. Then it downloads the JSON for each entry.

The sample below took 4 minutes and 45.294 seconds for me to run according to PowerShell. I did see something while it was download, but only because of verbose mode (`-v`). Without that, I would've had to wait that long before seeing anything. The log was over 10 mb and over 117,000 characters. Neither Discord nor GitHub would let me upload that as is. So I deleted all but the start and end from the log below.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading with `-R infinite`, the webpage downloading still retry only 3 times and the thumbnail downloading won't retry.

Recently, youtube terminates very frequently. Webpage downloading processes break often. Only the smallest thumbnail can be downloaded.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/WillPittenger)

[WillPittenger](https://github.com/WillPittenger)

opened [on Oct 3, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14532#issue-3479409313)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When `-t sleep` is set, yt-dlp needs to provide some indication of how long is left for sleep, particularly with long sleep periods. As is, it's hard to verify it hasn't hung. If yt-dlp is told to sleep for longer than a minute for some reason, It can be rather hard.

The log below ends when it'd be handy to have a countdown. yt-dlp didn't show any. 90 seconds was chosen mainly for exaggerated results.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Option to force resume support #14144

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

Copy link

Open

Open

Option to force resume support#14144

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/AstraKitten)

## Description

[](https://github.com/AstraKitten)

[AstraKitten](https://github.com/AstraKitten)

opened [on Aug 25, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14144#issue-3351126144)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I use yt-dlp as a downloader for very large files >100GB.  
The end point I use 100% always supports resume, and when interruped it almost always resumes.  
However sometimes something happens be it my Internet connection or the other end, and resume fails, and a 40-90+GB file just gets erased instantly.  
Even though it could've just tried again one more time and resume would've worked.

I think this area needs to be modified:  


[yt-dlp/yt_dlp/downloader/http.py](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/3bd91544122142a87863d79e54e995c26cfd7f92/yt_dlp/downloader/http.py#L143-L149)

Lines 143 to 149 in [3bd9154](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/3bd91544122142a87863d79e54e995c26cfd7f92)

|  # Content-Range is either not present or invalid. Assuming remote webserver is  
---|---  
|  # trying to send the whole file, resume is not possible, so wiping the local file  
|  # and performing entire redownload  
|  elif range_start > 0:   
|  self.report_unable_to_resume()   
|  ctx.resume_len = 0  
|  ctx.open_mode = 'wb'  
  
Adding a new flag like `--resume-always-supported` or similar and an else statement before that that'll just call the `RetryDownload` function again.

# Update Installation via package management documentation to clarify included dependencies #15051

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=)

Open

Update Installation via package management documentation to clarify included dependencies#15051

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/Runeloon)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Runeloon)

[Runeloon](https://github.com/Runeloon)

opened [on Nov 14, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15051#issue-3623554132)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've updated my installation via winget and it installed deno automatically as a dependency. Works without issue.

After reading through [#15012](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012) and install documentation, a potential issue I have is that how dependencies are required/managed aren't clear to a first-time user. The [Installation](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Installation) documentation doesn't note which of the listed package-managers deal with the sub-dependencies of an EJS or ffmpeg, and the README [Dependencies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#dependencies) section doesn't mention that a package manager distribution could deal with it. Both could result in users choosing an installation process that is either quick or laborious that doesn't work.

Maybe a mention in the Requirements about the package managers, and in the Installation page note for each package manager what dependencies they also install?

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Russia
